# permissions API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Scoped effective permissions use native current-web masks or selected-resource REST calls.

Current-page permission checks reuse native masks and make no REST requests.

Explicit web, list, item and folder targets for effective SharePoint permission checks.

## SPFxCrossSitePermissionsInfo

Information about cross-site permissions

### Imports

```ts
import type { SPFxCrossSitePermissionsInfo } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxCrossSitePermissionsInfo } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Examples

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SPFxCrossSitePermissionsInfo, useSPFxCrossSitePermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function Example() {
  const permissions: SPFxCrossSitePermissionsInfo = useSPFxCrossSitePermissions('https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/team');
  console.log(permissions.isLoading, permissions.error);
  return <span>{permissions.isLoading ? 'Loading' : 'Idle'}</span>;
}
```

## SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo

Effective permissions for one scoped resource. Missing, loading or failed
results make hasPermission false; server authorization still applies.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import type { SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Examples (3)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo, useSPFxCrossSitePermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function ListPermissionStatus() {
  const info: SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo = useSPFxCrossSitePermissions({ scope: 'list', listTitle: 'Tasks' });
  return <span>{info.error?.message ?? (info.isLoading ? 'Loading' : 'Ready')}</span>;
}
```

### Members (3)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo.error` | `Error \| undefined` | Required, readonly | — | Current validation/HTTP/payload error; undefined for loading or success. |
| `SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo.hasPermission` | `(permission: SPPermission) => boolean` | Required, readonly | — | Checks all bits in a native permission constant/mask, for UI presentation. |
| `SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo.isLoading` | `boolean` | Required, readonly | — | True while the current selected-resource request is pending; false for native-mask success or validation error. |
| `SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo.permissions` | `SPPermission \| undefined` | Required, readonly | — | Current resource's permission mask; undefined before success or on error/identity change. |

#### SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo.hasPermission (2)

##### Examples (4)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxCrossSitePermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';

// Render beneath the initialized host's matching SPFx provider.
function AddItemDecision() {
  const info = useSPFxCrossSitePermissions({});
  const allowed = info.hasPermission(SPPermission.addListItems);
  return <span>{info.error?.message ?? (info.isLoading ? 'Checking permissions' : allowed ? 'Can add items' : 'Add unavailable')}</span>;
}
```

##### Parameters (7)

- `permission`: Required native permission constant or combined mask.

##### Returns (7)

True only when the current resource contains every required bit.

## useSPFxCrossSitePermissions

Reads effective current-user permissions for exactly one resource. Current-web
scope reuses useSPFxPermissions when its native web mask is available; otherwise
REST reads the selected web/list/item/folder. Requires a matching SPFx provider.
Scalar-equivalent options do not refetch. Provider/client/user/target changes
hide former decisions during render; obsolete/unmounted results are ignored.
HTTP failure, invalid mask or folder/list mismatch produces error and no grant.

### Imports (4)

```ts
import { useSPFxCrossSitePermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { useSPFxCrossSitePermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Use when

- UI needs effective permissions for one selected resource.

### Throws

- When called outside an SPFx provider.

### Examples (6)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxCrossSitePermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';

function ItemPermissionStatus() {
  const info = useSPFxCrossSitePermissions({ scope: 'item', listTitle: 'Tasks', itemId: 42 });
  return <span>{info.error?.message ?? (info.isLoading ? 'Loading' : String(info.hasPermission(SPPermission.editListItems)))}</span>;
}
```

### Signatures (5)

```ts
(options: SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions): SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo
```

#### useSPFxCrossSitePermissions return.hasPermission

Contract: see [SPFxScopedPermissionsInfo.hasPermission](permissions.md#spfxscopedpermissionsinfo).

```ts
(siteUrl?: string | undefined, options?: SPFxCrossSitePermissionsOptions | undefined): SPFxCrossSitePermissionsInfo
```

Legacy site/web/list overload. Undefined/blank siteUrl remains idle. With a URL,
requests the collection root web and selected web masks plus an optional list mask; options.webUrl defaults
to siteUrl. Current identity changes hide previous sets before effects run.
Requires an SPFx provider. HTTP failures and invalid payloads expose error.

#### Parameters (10)

- `siteUrl`: Absolute HTTP(S) site URL; omitted/blank performs no request.
- `options`: Absolute web URL and list GUID; omitted or undefined uses siteUrl and skips the list mask.

#### Returns (10)

Compatible site/web/list sets, checks and loading/error state.

#### Throws (2)

- When called outside an SPFx provider.

#### Examples (7)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxCrossSitePermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';

function LegacyPermissionStatus() {
  const info = useSPFxCrossSitePermissions('https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/team', { listId: '11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555' });
  return <span>{String(info.hasListPermission(SPPermission.viewListItems))}</span>;
}
```

## useSPFxPermissions

Reads available site/web/list permission objects from PageContext without issuing requests. Helper checks return false for missing sets. These are presentation indicators; SharePoint enforces actual authorization.

### Imports (6)

```ts
import { useSPFxPermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { useSPFxPermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Use when (2)

- current-page UI needs native site/web/list permission indicators without an extra REST lookup.

### Avoid when

- a server operation needs authorization; enforce access on the server rather than trusting a UI check.

### Throws (3)

- When called outside an SPFx provider.

### Examples (9)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxPermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

import { SPPermission } from '@microsoft/sp-page-context';

function PermissionStatus() {
  const { hasWebPermission } = useSPFxPermissions();
  return <span>{hasWebPermission(SPPermission.addListItems) ? 'Can add' : 'Read only'}</span>;
}
```

```ts
(): SPFxPermissionsInfo
```

```ts
type PermissionListSelector = | {

      readonly listTitle?: never;
      /** Unavailable when selecting by ID. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
      readonly listPath?: never;
    }
  | {
      /** Exact, nonblank list title; mutually exclusive with ID/path. */

      readonly listPath?: never;

      readonly listPath: string;

      readonly listTitle?: never;
    }
```

## SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions

Selects one resource for effective current-user SharePoint permissions. Web is
the default scope; nonweb scopes require exactly one list ID, title or path.
Item IDs are positive integers. Folder paths are decoded server-relative paths
and must resolve to a folder in the selected list. Validation errors are exposed
through the hook result before a request. Requires a matching SPFx provider.

### Imports (7)

```ts
import type { SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Examples (10)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions, useSPFxCrossSitePermissions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function SelectedItem() {
  const target: SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions = {
    scope: 'item', listTitle: 'Tasks', itemId: 42,
  };
  const permission = useSPFxCrossSitePermissions(target);
  return <span>{permission.isLoading ? 'Loading' : 'Ready'}</span>;
}
```

### Type (2)

```ts
type SPFxScopedPermissionsOptions = PermissionWebTarget & (
  | {
      /** Resource scope; omitted selects the current/explicit web. */
      readonly scope?: 'web';
      /** Web scope does not accept a list selector. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
      readonly listId?: never;
      /** Web scope does not accept a list selector. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
      readonly listTitle?: never;
      /** Web scope does not accept a list selector. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
      readonly listPath?: never;
      /** Item IDs are accepted only by item scope. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
      readonly itemId?: never;
      /** Folder paths are accepted only by folder scope. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
      readonly folderPath?: never;
    }
  | (PermissionListSelector & (
      | {
          /** Select list effective permissions without querying site/web masks. */
          readonly scope: 'list';
          /** Item IDs are accepted only by item scope. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
          readonly itemId?: never;
          /** Folder paths are accepted only by folder scope. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
          readonly folderPath?: never;
        }
      | {
          /** Select the identified list item's effective permissions. */
          readonly scope: 'item';
          /** Required positive integer SharePoint item ID. */
          readonly itemId: number;
          /** Folder paths are accepted only by folder scope. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
          readonly folderPath?: never;
        }
      | {
          /** Select a folder's list-item effective permissions after validating list membership. */
          readonly scope: 'folder';
          /** Required decoded server-relative folder path with one leading slash. */
          readonly folderPath: string;
          /** Item IDs are accepted only by item scope. Omit or use undefined; non-undefined values reject. */
          readonly itemId?: never;
        }
    ))
)
```
